sourcePageFindings.reason: Page explains insulation deterioration/damage and current escaping intended path to equipment metal case.005/073 teach measurement connection/use, not this causal definition.080/096 name leakage testing without causal explanation.

Page describes earth conductor connecting apparatus to buried electrode and providing a current path into ground in its example.058 only warns against automatically removing earthing when a leakage breaker exists; it does not explain the path.
Page explicitly retains hazardous leakage state after earthing.058/031 preserve general protection/stop-report cautions but do not explicitly state earthing has not repaired the insulation defect.

Source includes a simplified ungrounded-leakage-breaker example. Do not teach that every ungrounded circuit has no current path, that every breaker guarantees prevention of shock, or universal installation requirements. Proposal correctly avoids those generalizations.

proposalAssessment.faultCausation: Supported; uses one possible leakage mechanism rather than defining every leakage case as metal-case current.
proposalAssessment.continuingFault: Supported; explicitly rejects continued use and avoids saying earth repairs insulation.
proposalAssessment.earthPath: Conceptually safe but the phrase「通り道に関わります」is weaker than the ledger learning outcome. Recommend explicit source-example-only path wording below before claiming that outcome fully closed.
proposalAssessment.complementaryProtection: Safely retains equipment-specific approved conditions and no removal/substitution guarantee; no current legal or code claim.
proposalAssessment.activity: Paper-only conceptual comparison; explicit no real-equipment confirmation.
proposalAssessment.safety: No touch-to-test,DIYinstallation,live test,protection modification or new operational recipe. Existing course stop/withdraw/report/qualification conventions preserved.
proposalAssessment.duplication: Some protection safeguards repeat058/031 intentionally; the three causal/path/residual-fault outcomes add explicit teaching absent in those linked lessons. This is not proof no implicit related concept exists elsewhere.

recommendedTeachingClarifications.before: 教材では、機器と接地極をアース線で結ぶ保護を説明しています。指定された接地は故障時の電流の通り道に関わりますが、接地があっても、傷んだ絶縁物そのものが直るわけではありません。漏電している機器を使い続けてよいとは判断しません。
recommendedTeachingClarifications.suggestedReplacement: この教材の例では、機器の金属部分と接地極をアース線で結び、故障時の漏れ電流が大地側へ流れる経路を設けています。ただし、接地があっても、傷んだ絶縁物そのものが直るわけではありません。漏電している機器を使い続けてよいとは判断しません。
recommendedTeachingClarifications.reason: Make protective fault-current route explicit while limiting it to the source example. Preserve no-repair/no-continued-use statement; do not add a universal no-shock/current-flow guarantee.
